status: preregistered (plan only; no build authorized, no code, no data)
process: LEAN (standing go t133s553 still needs a ledgered build_authorization_033 before any code): plan locked before data; seedcheck_033 before seeds are drawn; exact recount of ID/AMB/WRONG labels against the true machine; pre-freeze gates test on a sealed smoke block; failures published; evidence labels; one run, no tuning, no reruns
question: Can Brute pick its own actions to tell apart the machines that a passive trace cannot (active experiments, roadmap phase 4), so that 12-state worlds are exactly identified, soundly, where passive search leaves them ambiguous?
motivation: Studies 031 and 032 (Observed). In 031 the identify probe on S6 at 12 states gave ID 0/12, AMB 11/12 [0.646, 0.985], IDU 0/12, WRONG 0/12. S1 gave ID 0/12 at 12 states and 4/12 at 8 states. Inferred: the 176-step passive trace never exercises some truth transitions, so two or more non-isomorphic machines stay consistent. In 032, X_inf at noisy 12 states was 0/12 for every arm (S7, S7_contra, S5, S1). Better search on a fixed passive trace has not identified any 12-state world. The remaining lever is the data itself.

arms.A8: active: the same seeded passive 176-step prefix as every arm, then up to K = 64 extra actions chosen by Brute. Each round: (1) exact SAT search (S5 encoding, symmetry-free) for a least consistent machine M1, then a second consistent machine M2 not isomorphic to M1 (the 031 blocking clause); if none, stop with ID or WRONG; (2) BFS the product of M1 and M2 from their current states for the shortest input word w on which their output sequences differ (exists because they are non-isomorphic and minimal; else stop and report); (3) execute w on the world through the step-only wrapper, append the real readings, repeat until a single class remains or K is spent. Sound by construction: a model is eliminated only by real observations, and every final certificate is the S5 certificate on the extended trace
arms.A8_random: descriptive control for chosen vs more data: the same passive prefix plus exactly the number of extra actions A8 used on that seed (capped at K), drawn from the seeded random policy; then the same identify probe
arms.S5: passive v0.27.0 arm with the 031 identify probe on the 176-step trace, unchanged
arms.S1: passive baseline with the identify probe, unchanged (comparator)

design.world_access: a step-only wrapper over experiments/worlds_026.py: reset(seed) then step(action) -> reading; arms never see latent state, transitions or the true machine; the truth is used only by the scorer
design.labels: per case, as in 031: ID (exactly one class, equal to truth), AMB (two or more non-isomorphic consistent machines remain), WRONG (single class not equal to truth: a soundness failure), IDU (budget ran out). A8 also records rounds, extra actions used, and each distinguishing word
design.budget: experiment plus identify budget 120 s per case, the same for every arm; 10 s per SAT query hard cap; K = 64 extra actions; eps 0 (noise is out of scope here)
design.soundness: every distinguishing word is rechecked by simulation of M1 and M2 (outputs must differ), and the true machine is rechecked to stay consistent with the extended trace after every round

heldout_ranges.note: Fresh ranges following the study-number convention (032 used 98x0001). Drawn only after a ledgered seedcheck_033 confirms they are disjoint from every earlier plan, result and sealed archive. GAE8_headline.a: WRONG = 0 for every arm on every case
GAE8_headline.b: ID(A8, scale12) - ID(S5, scale12) >= +0.33 (4/12), paired seed-bootstrap 95% CI lower bound > 0
GAE8_headline.d: IDU(A8, scale12) <= 2/12 (so an ID shortfall is not just budget)

criteria.GCH8: ID(A8, scale12) - ID(A8_random, scale12) >= +0.17, paired CI lower bound > 0 (chosen data beats more data)
criteria.G_sound: every distinguishing word rechecked (M1 and M2 outputs differ); truth consistent with every extended trace; 0 failures
criteria.G10: controls: ID 6/6 for A8 and S5
criteria.GS_ref: exact reference on A8 (scale8): 0 label mismatches, mutation detection 20/20
criteria.G_PROC: process chain complete (plan, authorization, seedcheck, freeze, run_start, run_end, seal, before gates)
criteria.informational: ID/AMB at scale8 and scale16; extra actions used per ID; rounds; A8 vs S1; reported, not gated

runtime_estimate: about 1000-1500 s on 8 workers (36 cases, 4 arms, up to 120 s each); cap 1800 s, G_RT fails above it
what_counts_as_failure: any GAE8 clause failing, GCH8 or G_sound failing, any WRONG label; failures are published, not tuned
limitations: noise-free only (eps 0); active experiments on noisy worlds are not tested
K = 64 and the 120 s budget are fixed in advance and not tuned
the shortest distinguishing word for one pair is greedy, not an optimal experiment design over all surviving models
A8_random matches A8's action count per seed, so it inherits A8's stopping time
one world family (worlds_026), one hardware profile, one author; no independent replication
brand: charcoal and sage; no purple, neon, emoji or gold
freeze_rule: BRUTE_SOURCE_FREEZE_033 before run_start_033; frozen and ledger-hashed files are never edited
